title: Star Pact
msg.holdFree: Battle at {star}: the star stays free.
msg.pirate: {name} lost every star and turns pirate!
intro.conquer: Conquer: tap your star, then a target. Foreign stars mean a fight – the defender shoots first.
intro.build: Build: economy = money · industry = ships · science = research
intro.pacts: Pacts: negotiate out loud or in the secret phone chat – betrayal is allowed!
intro.goal: 100 points per star at the end. Holding {n} stars wins at once – otherwise it ends after {years} years.
intro.rounds: Rounds mode: 40 seconds of secret planning, then everyone flies at once.
note.spawn: Your new pirate fleet with {n} ships has arrived!
pirate.wait: You are a pirate: one year after your loss your fleet appears.
map.hint: Tap one of your stars to send a fleet.
map.hintPirate: Tap your pirate fleet (diamond), then a target.
map.pickTarget: Tap a target. Marked stars are in direct reach (range {n}); farther ones are reached via your stars.
plan.waiting: Done – waiting for the others (tap to undo)
build.pirate: As a pirate you have no stars to build on. Conquer a star and you're a normal empire again.
build.ind: +{n} ships per year per level at this star
build.sci: +1 research point per year per level
research.hint: Tap a technology to make it your goal. Points come from the science on your stars.
chat.nobody: Nobody here to write to – only computer empires.
chat.private: Only {name} and you can see this.
gift.tvNote: The TV only shows: “Someone sent someone something.”
phone.introText: On your phone you send fleets, build, research and chat in secret. Only you see your money and research.
watch.title: Star Pact
spd.gold: Gold star: double money from economy.
spd.yard: Shipyard: industry costs only half here.
spd.heart: Whoever holds it at the turn of the year gets 150 points.
spd.wh: Wormhole to {star}: the flight only takes as long as 1 field.
msg.heart: {name} holds the Heart of the Galaxy: +150 points!
intro.special: Special stars give bonuses. Nebulae block, wormholes connect.
intro.heart: The Heart of the Galaxy in the middle: +150 points for every year you hold it.
intro.missions: Everyone has 2 secret missions – points come at the end.
note.rally: Target star lost – new ships from {star} stay home again.
guard.label: Guard: ships that stay behind
pull.title: Bring ships to {star}
rally.title: Send new ships from {star} to …
pull.hint: Tap your stars that should send ships. The guard ({n}) stays at each star.
rally.hint: Tap the own star every newly built ship should fly to at once. The guard ({n}) stays here.
map.empty: No ships here – but you can bring ships here or set a target star.
route.via: Route with {n} stops at your stars.
build.cheapest: always builds at the cheapest star
missions.yours: Your secret missions (points at the end)
missions.secret: Only you can see them. Their points are added at the end.
mis.special: Own 3 special stars at the end
mis.heart: Hold the Heart of the Galaxy for at least 3 years
mis.ships: Have the most ships at the end
route.via1: Route with 1 stop at your star.
